title: Chrysanthemum Flower Show Display, 1950s Exhibition B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A close-up black-and-white snapshot capturing a competitive display of large, prize chrysanthemums arranged in tiered rows at a flower show or horticultural exhibition. Fluffy pompon and incurved mum blooms dominate the composition on tall stems, while shadowy silhouettes of attendees and decorative striped wall panels appear in the background, illustrating mid-20th-century floral fairs and garden club culture.
